title: Yuu Mob Chain
description: Hostile mob combo chains with XP and milestone rewards.
body:
# Yuu Mob Chain

Hostile mob combo chains with XP and milestone rewards.

## Features
- Killing hostile mobs in quick sequence builds a combo chain.
- Each chain step grants bonus XP.
- Milestone combos reward bonus item drops.
- Timeout logic keeps combat flow active and skill-based.

## Command
- `/mobchain [status|reset|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuumobchain.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
